_: Ling-3.2-air (inclusionAI/Ling-3.2-air, bailingmoe3) on maya-ling. "quants": Project Maya's quants of it (GGUF), named as every Maya quant (tools/maya_quants.py): one repo for the model. This table is the one switch: a size is offered by the setup and the Models page once "revision" names the repo's commit and the size has "files" with their sizes and sha256 (until then: --model ling-3.2-air-maya-s --model-dir <folder with the file>, checked against the size and sha256 here). A size with empty "files" is not offered and cannot be set up by its name: to switch one on, fill its "files" and "about" and move "revision" to the commit that has them. A file's name carries its quant type (IQ2_XXS, IQ2_S, IQ3_S): Hugging Face reads a repo's sizes from the names. Any other GGUF of the model: --model ling-3.2-air --model-dir <folder with the .gguf>.
name: Ling-3.2-air
